response.sql: WITH telescope_stats AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) as overall_avg FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL), station_avgs AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) as station_avg FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation) SELECT sa.observstation, sa.station_avg, sa.station_avg - ts.overall_avg as difference FROM station_avgs sa CROSS JOIN telescope_stats ts WHERE sa.station_avg IS NOT NULL AND sa.station_avg > ts.overall_avg ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10;
